newsitem.title: USA: PECO sees Pa. Limerick 2 nuke on line today.
newsitem.headline: PECO sees Pa. Limerick 2 nuke on line today.

text.p: PECO Energy Co said Monday its 1,055 megawatt (MW) Limerick 2 nuclear generating unit would return on line today following its weekend startup.
"It's supposed to be connected to the grid later today," said a PECO spokesman, adding the unit would likely resume full output by Wednesday.
The Pottsdam, Pa., unit was shut last Wednesday to repair a leaking seal in the condenser.
The adjacent unit, with an identical generating capacity, was "humming along" at 100 percent power, the spokesman said.
